capabilities.name: Round-and-group integer addition/subtraction
capabilities.description: Learner can simplify integer addition and subtraction by rounding to tens or hundreds and rearranging terms.

capabilities.name: Move terms with signs in mixed operations
capabilities.description: Learner can reorder mixed addition and subtraction by moving each term with its sign.

capabilities.name: Benchmark-number summation
capabilities.description: Learner can sum a set of close numbers by choosing a benchmark and compensating for differences.

capabilities.name: Arithmetic series sum
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate the sum of an arithmetic sequence by pairing first with last or applying the formula.

capabilities.name: Arithmetic series nth term and count
capabilities.description: Learner can find the nth term or the number of terms given the first term, last term, and common difference.

capabilities.name: Distributive law forward application
capabilities.description: Learner can expand expressions of the form a×(b±c) and compute the result efficiently.

capabilities.name: Factor out common terms
capabilities.description: Learner can factor a common multiplier out of a sum of products to create an easier calculation.

capabilities.name: Special-product multiplication patterns
capabilities.description: Learner can multiply by 11, 101, or similar numbers using observed place-value patterns.

capabilities.name: Friend-pair multiplication chaining
capabilities.description: Learner can chain multiplications using complement pairs such as 4×25 and 8×125 for quick mental math.

capabilities.name: Decompose divisor for successive division
capabilities.description: Learner can rewrite division by a composite number as successive divisions by its factors.

capabilities.name: Compensate dividend and divisor
capabilities.description: Learner can multiply or divide both dividend and divisor by the same number to create an easier division.

capabilities.name: Add/remove parentheses in mixed multiplication/division
capabilities.description: Learner can strategically add or remove parentheses in mixed multiplication and division to simplify.

capabilities.name: Decimal addition and subtraction
capabilities.description: Learner can accurately add and subtract decimal numbers using vertical alignment.

capabilities.name: Page-number digit counting
capabilities.description: Learner can count the total number of digits used to print consecutive page numbers from 1 to N.

capabilities.name: Adjacent area unit conversion
capabilities.description: Learner can convert between adjacent square units such as square meters, square decimeters, and square centimeters.

capabilities.name: Understand fraction meaning and unit fraction
capabilities.name_zh: 分数的意义与分数单位
capabilities.description: Learner can interpret a fraction as equal parts of a whole and identify its unit fraction.

capabilities.name: Represent quantities with letters
capabilities.description: Learner can use letters to express unknown quantities and quantitative relationships in formulas.

capabilities.name: Evaluate algebraic expressions
capabilities.description: Learner can substitute given numerical values for letters and evaluate the resulting expression.

capabilities.name: Solve simple linear equations
capabilities.description: Learner can solve equations of the form ax+b=cx+d by correctly moving terms across the equal sign.

capabilities.name: Draw line-segment diagrams for multiples
capabilities.name_zh: 画线段图表示倍数关系
capabilities.description: Learner can draw a standard line-segment diagram to visualize sum, difference, or multiple relationships in a problem.

capabilities.name: Basic sum-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve word problems where the sum of two quantities and an exact integer multiple relation are given.

capabilities.name: Sum-multiple with remainder
capabilities.name_zh: 和倍余量问题（几倍多/少几）
capabilities.description: Learner can solve sum-multiple problems where one quantity is a multiple plus or minus a fixed remainder.

capabilities.name: Hidden-sum sum-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can identify and solve sum-multiple problems where the total must be inferred from implicit conditions.

capabilities.name: Recognise sum-multiple vs difference-multiple
capabilities.description: Learner can read a word problem and decide whether it calls for a sum-multiple or a difference-multiple model.

capabilities.name: Basic difference-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve word problems where the difference and a multiple relation between two quantities are known.

capabilities.name: Difference-multiple with hidden difference
capabilities.description: Learner can solve difference-multiple problems where the difference must be derived from transfer or change conditions.

capabilities.name: Basic sum-difference problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve word problems where both the sum and the difference of two quantities are given.

capabilities.name: Integrated sum-difference-multiple problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve complex word problems that combine sum, difference, and multiple relations in a single scenario.

capabilities.name: Basic age problems with invariant difference
capabilities.description: Learner can solve age problems by applying sum-multiple or difference-multiple models while using the constant age difference.

capabilities.name: Age timeline 'when A was B's age' problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve age problems involving the phrase 'when A was B's current age' by constructing a timeline diagram.

capabilities.name: Cross-time age-sum problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve age problems that provide sums or multiples at past or future moments and relate them to present ages.

capabilities.name: Integrated age and multiple problems
capabilities.name_zh: 综合年龄与和差倍问题
capabilities.description: Learner can solve complex age problems that require combining multiple models and hidden conditions.

capabilities.name: Single-step reverse reasoning
capabilities.description: Learner can determine an original number from the result of a single inverse operation.

capabilities.name: Multi-step reverse reasoning
capabilities.description: Learner can work backwards through a chain of operations to recover the starting value.

capabilities.name: Reverse problems with half more/less
capabilities.name_zh: 还原问题中的一半多/少几
capabilities.description: Learner can reverse problems stated as taking half of a remainder and then adding or subtracting a number.

capabilities.name: Reverse problems with cost/remaining structure
capabilities.name_zh: 还原问题中的花费与剩余
capabilities.description: Learner can reverse real-world spending sequences that include fixed costs and fractional remainders.

capabilities.name: Basic Chicken-Rabbit by assumption
capabilities.name_zh: 假设法解基本鸡兔同笼
capabilities.description: Learner can solve classic head-and-leg Chicken-Rabbit problems using the assumption method.

capabilities.name: Value-type Chicken-Rabbit problems
capabilities.name_zh: 假设法解价值型鸡兔同笼
capabilities.description: Learner can solve assumption-method problems involving total monetary value or points rather than legs.

capabilities.name: Basic excess-shortage problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve distribution problems that yield one excess and one shortage by comparing the two scenarios.

capabilities.name: Advanced excess-shortage variants
capabilities.description: Learner can solve double-excess, double-shortage, and unit-quantity-change variants of profit-loss problems.

capabilities.name: Average and total interconversion
capabilities.description: Learner can compute an average from a total and count, and reconstruct a total from a known average.

capabilities.name: Move-more-to-less average diagram
capabilities.description: Learner can use the move-more-to-less diagram to relate individual values to the overall average.

capabilities.name: Two-group average to find count
capabilities.description: Learner can find the number of members in each group given the overall average and each group's separate average.

capabilities.name: Weighted average with changing members
capabilities.description: Learner can solve average problems where adding or removing a member changes the overall mean.

capabilities.name: Tree-planting on open routes
capabilities.description: Learner can solve interval problems on open segments for all three endpoint configurations.

capabilities.name: Tree-planting on closed routes
capabilities.description: Learner can solve interval problems on closed loops where the number of intervals equals the number of points.

capabilities.name: Sawing and stair-climbing intervals
capabilities.description: Learner can apply interval logic to count cuts, segments, or stairs in practical tasks.

capabilities.name: Queue and line spacing problems
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate the length of a queue or the spacing between arranged objects.

capabilities.name: Basic meeting problems
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate speed, time, or distance in a two-object meeting scenario moving in opposite directions.

capabilities.name: Basic chasing problems
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate speed, time, or distance in a two-object chasing scenario moving in the same direction.

capabilities.name: Queue relative-motion problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve queue-length problems that combine meeting and chasing relative motion.

capabilities.name: Two-set inclusion-exclusion
capabilities.description: Learner can apply the inclusion-exclusion formula for two sets and account for a possible neither region.

capabilities.name: Three-set inclusion-exclusion
capabilities.name_zh: 三元容斥原理与韦恩图
capabilities.description: Learner can apply the inclusion-exclusion formula for three sets and interpret a three-circle Venn diagram.

capabilities.name: Inclusion-exclusion with explicit neither
capabilities.description: Learner can solve inclusion-exclusion problems that include a count of elements outside all sets.

capabilities.name: Find cycle and remainder in periodic problems
capabilities.name_zh: 周期问题找规律与余数
capabilities.description: Learner can identify the repeating cycle in a sequence or action and use remainders to predict states.

capabilities.name: Calendar spanning-month weekday calculation
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate the number of days between dates across months and determine the resulting weekday.

capabilities.name: Integrated periodic and calendar problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve complex problems combining periodic cycles with calendar arithmetic and finger-counting patterns.

capabilities.name: Count line segments and angles
capabilities.description: Learner can count line segments or angles in a figure by sequential addition from a common vertex.

capabilities.name: Single-layer triangle counting
capabilities.description: Learner can count triangles in a single-layer figure by analyzing bases on one line.

capabilities.name: Add-line method for triangle counting
capabilities.description: Learner can count triangles in composite figures by adding the contribution of each newly added line.

capabilities.name: Count rectangles in grid
capabilities.description: Learner can count rectangles in a rectangular grid by multiplying horizontal and vertical segment counts.

capabilities.name: Count squares in regular grid
capabilities.description: Learner can count squares of all sizes in a regular grid by summing layerwise counts.

capabilities.name: Count squares in irregular/overlapping shapes
capabilities.name_zh: 不规则与重叠图形数正方形
capabilities.description: Learner can count squares in irregular or overlapping figures using decomposition and inclusion-exclusion.

capabilities.name: Systematic enumeration by dictionary order
capabilities.description: Learner can enumerate partitions or combinations in non-decreasing dictionary order without omission.

capabilities.name: Addition principle by classification
capabilities.description: Learner can partition a set of possibilities into mutually exclusive classes and sum their counts.

capabilities.name: Multiplication principle by steps
capabilities.description: Learner can break a counting task into independent sequential steps and multiply their counts.

capabilities.name: Recognise order and repetition constraints
capabilities.name_zh: 识别计数问题中的有序与可重
capabilities.description: Learner can read a counting problem and determine whether order matters and whether repetition is allowed.

capabilities.name: Arrangements with repeated digits allowed
capabilities.description: Learner can count numbers or codes formed from digits when repetition is permitted.

capabilities.name: Permutations without repeated digits
capabilities.description: Learner can count numbers or arrangements formed from digits when no repetition is allowed.

capabilities.name: Tree-diagram enumeration with adjacency constraints
capabilities.description: Learner can use tree diagrams to count sequences with restrictions such as adjacent items being different.

capabilities.name: Additive numbering for shortest paths
capabilities.description: Learner can count shortest paths on a grid by labelling each intersection with the number of ways to reach it.

capabilities.name: Transform real map to point-line graph
capabilities.description: Learner can convert a floorplan or map into a graph of points and lines to analyze traversals.

capabilities.name: Euler-path feasibility by odd vertices
capabilities.name_zh: 奇点个数与一笔画判断
capabilities.description: Learner can count odd vertices to determine whether a connected graph can be drawn in one continuous stroke.

capabilities.name: Maximum lines through points
capabilities.name_zh: 平面点确定最多直线数
capabilities.description: Learner can determine the maximum number of lines determined by N points with no three collinear.

capabilities.name: Partition integer into distinct piles
capabilities.name_zh: 整数拆分成不同堆枚举
capabilities.description: Learner can enumerate ways to split an integer into a specified number of distinct positive summands.

capabilities.name: Distribute identical items to distinct people
capabilities.name_zh: 相同物品分给不同人枚举
capabilities.description: Learner can enumerate ways to distribute identical objects to distinct recipients under constraints.

capabilities.name: Basic parity of sum, difference, product
capabilities.name_zh: 和差积基本奇偶性判定
capabilities.description: Learner can determine whether the result of an addition, subtraction, or multiplication is odd or even.

capabilities.name: Parity of chained multiplications
capabilities.description: Learner can determine the parity of a product chain using the all-odd versus any-even rule.

capabilities.name: Parity invariance impossibility proofs
capabilities.name_zh: 奇偶不变量证明不可能
capabilities.description: Learner can use parity invariants to prove that certain end states are impossible in operation games.

capabilities.name: Parity analysis in coin-flipping games
capabilities.description: Learner can apply parity analysis to state-changing games such as flipping coins or hats.

capabilities.name: Insert operators by reverse reasoning
capabilities.description: Learner can insert operators and parentheses into short expressions by working backwards from the target result.

capabilities.name: Insert operators in long digit strings by target approximation
capabilities.description: Learner can construct a value near the target in a long uniform-digit expression and adjust with remaining digits.

capabilities.name: Correct addition/subtraction errors by place value
capabilities.description: Learner can determine the correct result or misread digit by analyzing how place-value errors affect the sum.

capabilities.name: Matchstick digit optimization
capabilities.description: Learner can rearrange matchstick digits to maximize or minimize a sum under digit-uniqueness constraints.

capabilities.name: Nonogram logic deduction
capabilities.description: Learner can deduce black-and-white cell placements from row and column run-length clues.

capabilities.name: Rectangle and square perimeter formulas
capabilities.name_zh: 长方形与正方形周长公式
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the perimeter of rectangles and squares using standard formulas.

capabilities.name: Translation method for irregular perimeters
capabilities.name_zh: 平移法求不规则图形周长
capabilities.description: Learner can translate protruding segments to form a bounding rectangle and compute the resulting perimeter.

capabilities.name: Deduce perimeter from length-plus-width sum
capabilities.description: Learner can compute a rectangle's perimeter when only the sum of one length and one width is provided.

capabilities.name: Rectangle and square area formulas
capabilities.name_zh: 长方形与正方形面积公式
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the area of rectangles and squares from side lengths.

capabilities.name: Derive side lengths from area relations
capabilities.description: Learner can deduce unknown side lengths in composite figures from given areas and shared sides.

capabilities.name: Composite rectangle area puzzles
capabilities.name_zh: 长方形拼图与已知区域求未知
capabilities.description: Learner can solve area puzzles where a large rectangle is partitioned into smaller rectangles and a square.

capabilities.name: Shaded area of overlapping strips
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate the shaded area formed by overlapping parallel strips using inclusion-exclusion or translation.

capabilities.name: Parallelogram area via base and height
capabilities.description: Learner can calculate the area of a parallelogram using base multiplied by the corresponding height.

capabilities.name: Perpendicular-diagonal quadrilateral area
capabilities.name_zh: 对角线垂直四边形面积
capabilities.description: Learner can compute the area of a quadrilateral with perpendicular diagonals as half the product of the diagonals.

capabilities.name: Rhombus area and perimeter interconversion
capabilities.description: Learner can find the side length or perimeter of a rhombus given its area and a height or diagonal length.

capabilities.name: Integrated plane geometry measurement
capabilities.name_zh: 综合平面几何度量问题
capabilities.description: Learner can solve complex geometry problems that require combining perimeter, area, translation, and derived formulas.

capabilities.name: Set up equations for word problems
capabilities.description: Learner can translate a word problem into a simple equation and solve for the unknown.

capabilities.name: Recognise problem type among sum/difference/multiple models
capabilities.name_zh: 识别和差倍应用题类型
capabilities.description: Learner can read a word problem and identify which of the sum-difference-multiple models applies before selecting a method.

capabilities.name: Recognise geometry strategy: translation vs direct formula
capabilities.name_zh: 识别几何解题策略（平移或直接公式）
capabilities.description: Learner can inspect a composite shape and decide whether to use segment translation or direct formula application.

capabilities.name: Recognise operator-insertion strategy
capabilities.description: Learner can inspect an operator-insertion problem and choose between reverse reasoning, target approximation, or trial.

capabilities.name: Represent inclusion-exclusion data with Venn diagrams
capabilities.name_zh: 用韦恩图表示容斥数据
capabilities.description: Learner can organize given set data into a two- or three-circle Venn diagram to visualize overlaps.

capabilities.name: Represent reverse problems with flowcharts
capabilities.name_zh: 用流程图表示还原问题
capabilities.description: Learner can draw a forward flowchart of operations to support systematic reverse calculation.

capabilities.name: Check solution plausibility in word problems
capabilities.name_zh: 应用题结果合理性检验
capabilities.description: Learner can verify whether a computed answer satisfies all original conditions of a word problem.

capabilities.name: Sum-multiple with transfer and change
capabilities.name_zh: 移多补少型暗和倍问题
capabilities.description: Learner can solve sum-multiple problems where quantities are transferred and the sum changes implicitly.

capabilities.name: Age problem with sum at different epochs
capabilities.name_zh: 不同时间点年龄和差倍问题
capabilities.description: Learner can solve age problems where the sum of ages is given at a past or future time and relate it to the present.

capabilities.name: Interval problem with explicit end-point cases
capabilities.name_zh: 植树问题两端情况辨析
capabilities.description: Learner can distinguish whether an interval problem includes points at both ends, one end, or neither and adjust counts accordingly.

capabilities.name: Multiplication principle with restriction handling
capabilities.name_zh: 乘法原理处理限制条件
capabilities.description: Learner can apply the multiplication principle when later choices are reduced by earlier selections such as no-repetition rules.

capabilities.name: Integrated flexible integer calculation
capabilities.description: Learner can fluently choose and combine rounding, factoring, distributive law, and quotient invariance to simplify complex integer expressions.

capabilities.name: Integrated counting and combinatorics
capabilities.description: Learner can solve complex counting problems that require combining enumeration, addition and multiplication principles, and geometric counting.

capabilities.name: Integrated composite word problems
capabilities.description: Learner can solve multi-step word problems that integrate several models such as sum-difference-multiple, age, average, reverse, Chicken-Rabbit, and interval logic.
